title: The Solaria Universe
tagline: Zodiac Academy · Ruthless Boys · Darkmore · Sins of the Zodiac
intro: Caroline Peckham & Susanne Valenti's Fae world spans four series, a shelf of novellas, charity-anthology stories and group-only freebies. This section gathers all of it: the reading paths, every companion story and where to find it, how the series fit on the timeline, and maps.

guides.blurb: The whole universe in one spoiler-safe path, every bonus story slotted in.
Optional: ZA8 and ZA8.5 chapter by chapter (fan order — the authors suggest reading 8.5 after 8).

crossovers.title: Ruthless Boys ↔ Zodiac Academy

title: Throne of Glass
tagline: Erilea · eight books · six hidden scenes
intro: Sarah J. Maas's first series — Celaena Sardothien's story across eight books and a prequel collection. Beyond the books there are six bonus scenes scattered across blog tours and retailer exclusives, and one famous fan-made tandem read.
